gfx942 and gfx950.

items.name: b12801
items.body:
<details open>

ggml/CUDA+HIP: Flash Attention with indexed bias (#33063)

* cuda : port indexed bias FA onto the refactored loaders

Replays the #32740 bias support on the shared typed tile loader, adds bias
in F32 to match the CPU reference and routes rows via KV_indirection.

* cuda : return zeros for a fully masked FA query row

An all -inf mask row has a zero softmax sum, which divided gave NaN. Guard
the tile, vec and results-combine divisions so it gives zeros, as ggml-cpu.

* Code review from Fable
* fixup! cuda : port indexed bias FA onto the refactored loaders

</details>
